thag21.1:1.1: Saṭṭhiko nipāto. MAHĀNIPĀTO. Nikkhantaṃ vata maṃ santaṃ agārasmā anagāriyaṃ vitakkā upadhāvanti pagabbhā Kaṇhato ime: || ||
thag21.1:2.1: uggaputtā mahissāsā sikkhitā daḷhadhammino samantā parikireyyuṃ sahassaṃ apalāyinaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:3.1: sace pi ettakā bhiyyo āgamissanti itthiyo, n' eva maṃ byādhayissanti; dhammesv amhi patiṭṭhito. || ||
thag21.1:4.1: sakiṃ hi me sutaṃ etaṃ buddhassādiccabandhuno nibbānagamanaṃ maggaṃ, tattha me nirato mano. || ||
thag21.1:5.1: evam evaṃ viharantaṃ pāpima upagacchasi; tathā Maccu karissāmi: na me maggaṃ udikkhasi. || ||
thag21.1:6.1: aratiṃ ratiṃ ca pahāya sabbaso gehasitañ ca vitakkaṃ vanathaṃ na kareyya kuhiñci, nibbanathā avanatho sa hi bhikkhu. || ||
thag21.1:7.1: yam idha pathaviñ ca vihāsaṃ rūpagataṃ jagatogandhaṃ kiñci, parijiyyati sabbam aniccaṃ: evaṃ samecca caranti muttantā. || ||
thag21.1:8.1: upadhīsu janā gandhitāse diṭṭhasute paṭighe ca mute ca; ettha vinodaya chandam anejo; yo h' ettha na lippati muni tam āhu. || ||
thag21.1:9.1: aṭṭhasaṭṭhisitā savitakkā puthujjanatāya adhammaniviṭṭhā; na ca vaggagatissa kuhiñci, no pana padullagāhī sa bhikkhu. || ||
thag21.1:10.1: Dabbo cirarattaṃ samāhito akuhako nipako apihālu santaṃ padam ajjhagamā muni, paṭiccaparinibbuto kaṅkhati kālaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:11.1: mānaṃ pajahassu Gotama mānapathañ ca jahassu asesaṃ; mānapathamhi samucchito vippaṭisārī hutvā cirarattaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:12.1: makkhena makkhitā pajā mānahatā nirayaṃ patanti, socanti janā cirarattaṃ mānahatā nirayaṃ upapannā. || ||
thag21.1:13.1: na hi socati bhikkhu kadāci maggajino sammā paṭipanno, kittiñ ca sukhañ ca nubhoti, dhammadaso 'ti tam āhu tathattaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:14.1: tasmā akhilo idham amānavā nīvaraṇāni pahāya visuddho mānañ ca pahāya asesaṃ vijjāy' antakaro samitāvī. || ||
thag21.1:15.1: kamarāgena ḍayhāmi, cittaṃ me pariḍayhati; sādhu nibbāpanaṃ brūhi anukampāya Gotama. || ||
thag21.1:16.1: saññāya vipariyesā cittan te pariḍayhati; nimittaṃ parivajjehi subhaṃ rāgūpasaṃhitaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:17.1: asubhāya cittaṃ bhāvehi ekaggaṃ susamāhitaṃ, sati kāyagatā ty atthu, nibbidābahulo bhava. || ||
thag21.1:18.1: animittañ ca bhāvehi, mānānusayam ujjaha, tato mānābhisamayā upasanto carissasi. || ||
thag21.1:19.1: tam eva vācaṃ bhāseyya yāy' attānaṃ na tāpaye pare ca na vihiṃseyya; sā ve vācā subhāsitā. || ||
thag21.1:20.1: piyavācam eva bhāseyya yā vācā paṭinanditā yaṃ anādāya pāpāni paresaṃ bhāsate piyaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:21.1: saccaṃ ve amatā vācā, esa dhammo sanantano; sacce atthe ca dhamme ca āhu santo paṭiṭṭhitā. || ||
thag21.1:22.1: yaṃ buddho bhāsatī vācaṃ khemaṃ nibbānapattiyā dukkhass' antakiriyāya, sa ve vācānam uttamā. || ||
thag21.1:23.1: gambhīrapañño mehāvī maggāmaggassa kovido Sāriputto mahāpañño dhammaṃ deseti bhikkhunaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:24.1: saṃkhittena pi deseti vitthārena pi bhāsati, sālikāye va nigghoso paṭibhānaṃ udīyyati. || ||
thag21.1:25.1: tassa taṃ desayantassa suṇantā madhuraṃ giraṃ sarena rajanīyena savanīyena vaggunā udaggacittā muditā sotaṃ odhenti bhikkhavo. || ||
thag21.1:26.1: ajja pannarase visuddhiyā bhikkhū pañcasatā samagatā saṃyojanabandhanacchidā anīghā khīṇapunabbhavā isī. || ||
thag21.1:27.1: cakkavattī yathā rājā amaccaparivārito samantā anupariyeti sāgarantaṃ mahiṃ imaṃ, || ||
thag21.1:28.1: evaṃ vijitasaṃgāmaṃ satthavāhaṃ anuttaraṃ sāvakā payirupāsanti tevijjā maccuhāyino, || ||
thag21.1:29.1: sabbe bhagavato puttā, palāpo ettha na vijjati; taṇhāsallassa hantāraṃ vande ādiccabandhunaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:30.1: parosahassaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sugataṃ payirupāsati desentaṃ virajaṃ dhammaṃ nibbānaṃ akutobhayaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:31.1: suṇanti dhammaṃ vipulaṃ sammāsambuddhadesitaṃ; sobhati vata sambuddho bhikkhusaṃghapurakkhato. || ||
thag21.1:32.1: nāganāmo 'si bhagavā, isīnaṃ isisattamo, mahāmegho va hutvāna sāvake abhivassasi. || ||
thag21.1:33.1: divāvihārā nikkhamma satthudassanakamyatā sāvako te mahāvīra pāde vandati Vaṅgiso. || ||
thag21.1:34.1: ummaggapathaṃ Mārassa abhibhuyya carati pabhijja khilāni; taṃ passatha bandhanapamuñcakaraṃ asitaṃ va bhāgaso pavibhajja. || ||
thag21.1:35.1: oghassa hi nittharaṇatthaṃ anekavihitaṃ maggaṃ akkhāsi, tasmiñ ca amate akkhāte dhammadasā ṭhitā asaṃhīrā. || ||
thag21.1:36.1: pajjotakaro ativijjha sabbaṭṭhitīnaṃ atikkamam addā, ñatvā ca sacchikatvā ca aggaṃ so desayi dasaddānaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:37.1: evaṃ sudesite dhamme ko pamādo vijānataṃ dhammaṃ, tasmā hi tassa bhagavato sāsane appamatto sadā namassam anusikkhe. || ||
thag21.1:38.1: buddhānubuddho yo thero Koṇḍañño tibbanikkhamo, lābhī sukhavihārānaṃ vivekānaṃ abhiṇhaso, || ||
thag21.1:39.1: yaṃ sāvakena pattabbaṃ satthusāsanakārinā, sabb' assa taṃ anuppattaṃ appamattassa sikkhato. || ||
thag21.1:40.1: mahānubhāvo tevijjo cetopariyakovido Koṇḍañño buddhadāyādo pāde vandati satthuno. || ||
thag21.1:41.1: nāgassa passe āsīnaṃ muniṃ dukkhassa pāraguṃ sāvakā pariyupāsanti tevijjā maccuhāyino. || ||
thag21.1:42.1: cetasā anupariyeti Moggallāno mahiddhiko cittaṃ nesaṃ samanvesaṃ vippamuttaṃ nirūpadhiṃ. || ||
thag21.1:43.1: evaṃ sabbaṅgasampannaṃ muniṃ dukkhassa pāraguṃ anekākārasampannaṃ payirupāsanti Gotamaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:44.1: cando yathā vigatavalāhake nabhe virocati vītamalo va bhānumā, evam pi Aṅgīrasa tvaṃ mahāmuni atirocasī yasasā sabbalokaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:45.1: kāveyyamattā vicarimha pubbe gāmā gāmaṃ purā puraṃ, {ath' addasāmi sambuddhaṃ} sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ. || ||
thag21.1:46.1: so me dhammam adesesi muni dukkhassa pāragū; dhammaṃ sutvā pasīdimha, saddhā no udapajjatha. || ||
thag21.1:47.1: tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā khandhe āyatanāni ca dhātuyo ca viditvāna pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:48.1: bahūnaṃ vata atthāya uppajjanti tathāgatā itthīnaṃ purisānañ ca ye te sāsanakārakā. || ||
thag21.1:49.1: tesaṃ kho vata atthāya bodhiṃ ajjhagamā muni bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnañ ca ye niyāmagataṃdasā. || ||
thag21.1:50.1: sudesitā cakkhumatā buddhenādiccabandhunā cattāri ariyasaccāni anukampāya pāṇinaṃ, || ||
thag21.1:51.1: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ ariyaṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ dukkhūpasamagāminaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:52.1: evam ete tathā vuttā, diṭṭhā me te yathātathā; sadattho me anuppatto, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:53.1: svāgataṃ vata me āsi mama buddhassa santike; saṃvibhattesu dhammesu yaṃ seṭṭhaṃ tad upāgamiṃ. || ||
thag21.1:55.1: pucchāmi satthāram anomapaññaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme yo vicikicchānaṃ chetvā: Aggāḷave kālam akāsi bhikkhu ñāto yasassī abhinibbutatto; || ||
thag21.1:56.1: Nigrodhakappo iti tassa nāmaṃ tayā kataṃ bhagavā brāhmaṇassa, so taṃ namassaṃ acari mutyapekho āraddhaviriyo daḷhadhammadassī: || ||
thag21.1:57.1: taṃ sāvakaṃ Sakka mayam pi sabbe aññātum icchāma samantacakkhu: samavaṭṭhitā no savanāya sotaṃ, tuvaṃ nu satthā tvam anuttaro 'si. || ||
thag21.1:58.1: chind' eva no vicikicchaṃ, brūhi me taṃ, parinibbutaṃ vedaya bhūripañña, majjheva no bhāsa samantacakkhu Sakko va devāna sahassanetto. || ||
thag21.1:59.1: ye keci gandhā idha mohamaggā aññāṇapakkhā vicikicchaṭṭhānā, tathāgataṃ patvā na te bhavanti, cakkhuṃ hi etaṃ paramaṃ narānaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:60.1: no ce hi jātu puriso kilese vāto yathā abbhaghanaṃ vihāne, tamo 'v' assa nibbuto sabbaloko, jotimanto pi na pabhāseyyuṃ. || ||
thag21.1:61.1: dhīrā ca pajjotakarā bhavanti, taṃ taṃ ahaṃ dhīra tath' eva maññe, vipassinaṃ jānam upāgamimha; parisāya no āvikarohi Kappaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:62.1: khippaṃ giraṃ eraya vaggu vagguṃ haṃso va paggayha sanikaṃ nikūjaṃ bindussarena suvikappitena; sabbeva te ujjugatā suṇoma. || ||
thag21.1:63.1: pahīnajātimaraṇaṃ asesaṃ niggayha dhonaṃ vadessāmi dhammaṃ; na kāmakāro hi puthujjanānaṃ, saṃkheyyakāro 'va tathāgatānaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:64.1: sampannaveyyākaraṇaṃ tavedaṃ samujjapaññassa samuggahītaṃ; ayam añjali pacchimo suppaṇāmito; mā mohayi jānam anomapañña. || ||
thag21.1:65.1: parovaraṃ ariyadhammaṃ viditvā mā mohayi jānam anomaviriya; vāriṃ yathā ghammanighammatatto vācābhikaṅkhāmi, sutaṃ pavassa. || ||
thag21.1:66.1: yadatthiyaṃ brahmacariyaṃ acāri Kappāyano kacci 'ssa taṃ amoghaṃ; nibbāyi so ādu saupādiseso; yathā vimutto ahu taṃ suṇoma. || ||
thag21.1:67.1: acchecchi taṇhaṃ idha nāmarūpe 'ti bhagavā, taṇhāya sotaṃ dīgharattānusayitaṃ atāri jātimaraṇaṃ asesaṃ icc' abravī bhagavā pañcaseṭṭho. || ||
thag21.1:68.1: esa sutvā pasīdāmi vaco te isisattama, amoghaṃ kira me puṭṭhaṃ, na maṃ vañcesi brāhmaṇo. || ||
thag21.1:69.1: yathāvādī tathākārī ahū buddhassa sāvako, acchecchi Maccuno jālaṃ tataṃ māyāvino daḷhaṃ. || ||
thag21.1:70.1: addasa bhagavā ādiṃ upādānassa Kappiyo, accagā vata Kappāyano maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ. || ||
thag21.1:71.1: taṃ devadevaṃ vandāmi puttaṃ te dvipaduttama anujātaṃ mahāvīraṃ nāgaṃ nāgassa orasan ti. || || itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Vaṅgīsotherogāthāyo abhāsitthā 'ti. Mahānipāto niṭṭhito.
thag21.1:72.0: Sattatimhi nipātamhi Vaṅgīso paṭibhāṇavā eko 'va thero, n' atth' añño, gāthāyo ekasattati. | sahassaṃ honti tā gāthā
thag21.1:73.0: tīṇi saṭṭhisatāni ca, therā ca dve satā saṭṭhi cattāro ca pakāsitā. |
thag21.1:74.1: sīhanādaṃ naditvāna buddhaputtā anāsavā khemantaṃ pāpuṇitvāna aggikkhandhā va nibbutā 'ti. Niṭṭhitā Theragāthāyo.
